title: Humanizer
description: Transform strings, dates, numbers, and enums into human-readable forms.

data.text: `Humanizer` transforms machine-generated values into human-friendly strings. It handles pluralization, date formatting, number-to-words, enum descriptions, and string casing with support for dozens of locales.
Humanizer extends `string`, `DateTime`, `TimeSpan`, numbers, and enums with helpful methods.

data.title: Humanizer Basics

data.text: Humanizer automatically handles singular and plural forms based on quantity.

terms.definition: Transforms a string, date, or enum into a human-readable form.
Combines a quantity with a word, handling pluralization automatically.
Converts a number into its word representation.

data.title: Tip
data.text: Humanizer supports over 50 locales. Set the culture explicitly for multilingual applications: `CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture = new CultureInfo("fr");`

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Humanizer works on strings, dates, numbers, and enums
Supports many locales for international apps
Requires no configuration to get started
data.takeaway: Humanizer makes your application feel more natural with minimal effort.
